_comment: Floors the golden-set eval must clear. CI fails the build when a measured
* A floor is set BELOW the current measured value, not at it — retrieval
has run-to-run variance and a floor pinned to the exact current number
turns normal noise into red builds, which trains people to ignore the gate.
* A metric that was never measured is `null` here and is NOT enforced.
Enforcing a threshold on an unmeasured metric would fail every build for
a reason unrelated to the change under review.
* Raise a floor deliberately, in the same PR that improves the metric.
